::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Zechariah encourages God's people through visions of restoration and prophecies concerning the coming Messiah. The book teaches that God will complete His redemptive purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Zechariah 1:3
Return unto Me, and I will return unto you
### Why This Verse Central restoration theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls the people to repentance and introduces Zechariah's night visions. The key verse emphasizes God's willingness to return to those who return to Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Zechariah 2:5
I will be unto her a wall of fire
### Why This Verse Divine protection ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the vision of Jerusalem's future expansion and protection. The key verse highlights God's presence dwelling among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Zechariah 3:2
The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan
### Why This Verse Quoted in Jude ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents Joshua the high priest being cleansed. The key verse reveals God's grace in removing sin and points to the coming Branch (Messiah). ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Zechariah 4:6
Not by might, nor by power, but by My Spirit
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted prophetic verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the vision of the lampstand and olive trees. The key verse teaches that God's work is accomplished by His Spirit rather than human strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Zechariah 5:1
I looked, and behold a flying roll
### Why This Verse Memorable vision ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains visions of judgment against sin. The key verse emphasizes God's commitment to removing wickedness from among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Zechariah 6:12
Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH
### Why This Verse Messianic prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes the night visions and symbolically crowns Joshua. The key verse points to the coming Priest-King who will build God's temple. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Zechariah 7:9
Execute true judgment
### Why This Verse Justice and mercy ### Chapter Insight This chapter answers questions about fasting. The key verse emphasizes obedience, justice, and mercy over religious ritual. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Zechariah 8:23
We will go with you, for we have heard God is with you
### Why This Verse Nations drawn to God ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises Jerusalem's future blessing and restoration. The key verse reveals God's zeal for Zion and His intention to bless His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Zechariah 9:9
Thy King cometh unto thee
### Why This Verse Triumphal entry prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter foretells judgment on Israel's enemies and the coming King. The key verse describes the Messiah entering Jerusalem humbly on a donkey. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Zechariah 10:1
Ask ye of the LORD rain
### Why This Verse Dependence on God ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises God's care and restoration for His people. The key verse portrays God as the Shepherd who gathers and strengthens His flock. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Zechariah 11:12
Thirty pieces of silver
### Why This Verse Messianic prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter depicts the rejection of the Good Shepherd. The key verse prophetically foreshadows the betrayal of the Messiah for thirty pieces of silver. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Zechariah 12:10
They shall look upon Me whom they have pierced
### Why This Verse Major messianic prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter foretells Jerusalem's future deliverance. The key verse points to a time when people will look upon the One they pierced and mourn. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Zechariah 13:1
A fountain opened for sin and uncleanness
### Why This Verse Redemption imagery ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises cleansing from sin and refining of God's people. The key verse foretells the striking of the Shepherd and the scattering of the sheep. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Zechariah 14:9
The LORD shall be King over all the earth
### Why This Verse Climactic kingdom promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the Day of the Lord and God's final reign. The key verse declares that the Lord will be King over all the earth. :::
